title: Disney’s Fired C.E.O. Bob Chapek Settles Scores With Bob Iger in New Book
summary: In a new memoir, Bob Chapek publicly addresses his 2022 ouster for the first time. He blames Mr. Iger, who both preceded and succeeded him at Disney.
